integrity_notes: The standalone verifier exhaustively compares modal operator semantics and endpoint criteria for 74,954 finite relations, and tests exact enumerations and asymptotic constants. Unbounded parameter claims are proved mathematically, not by finite tests. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Finite positive-length Alexandrov chains with unrestricted binary relations. The asymptotic requires a fixed target size at least three. No infinite-domain or joint-size asymptotic theorem; no modal axiomatization. Structural semicontinuity tests and semistandard tableau hook-content formula are prior results. Inaccessible older isotone-relations literature remains an originality risk.
title: A weighted-tableau census and universal quarter-law for continuous Alexandrov relations
